headline: One play on a one-game night: Michael Pittman Jr. over 3.5 receptions at +134. Game lines are tight and the three touchdown props that cleared the bar were cut.

games.note: One play (Pittman receptions). Spread, moneyline and total are all priced below fair at DraftKings; Pinnacle has barely moved since the morning. Weather is a non-factor: mid-70s, wind around 9 mph, showers only a late-game risk.

picks.subject: Michael Pittman Jr.
picks.label: Michael Pittman Jr. over 3.5 receptions
picks.reason: DraftKings (+134) is well off the market: Pinnacle's no-vig price and four other books both put four catches at 45% (FanDuel +106, BetMGM +100); he is off the injury report after the Week 2 foot issue and ran routes on 78% of dropbacks in his first game back.

passed.label: Jerry Jeudy anytime TD +950 (+7.1%)
passed.why: No targets in two straight games and no end-zone looks this season; the edge on a 9-to-1 shot depends on how Pinnacle's juice is split and I found no news explaining why DraftKings would be off.

passed.label: Pat Freiermuth anytime TD +400 (+5.6%)
passed.why: DraftKings matches Bovada (+400) and BetMGM (+390), so it is not out of line with the market; his route share has slipped to about 57% with Darnell Washington at a season high, and he has no red-zone targets.

passed.label: KC Concepcion anytime TD +360 (+5.0%)
passed.why: Sits exactly on the 5% bar with DraftKings level with FanDuel and Bovada; his targets are short-area (3.8 air yards) while the end-zone looks go to Boston and Fannin, behind a line missing two starters.

passed.label: Harold Fannin Jr. anytime TD +295 (+2.5%)
passed.why: Below the 5% bar for touchdown props.

notes: Single-game night: 1u at risk against a 4u cap. No parlay: only one play, and parlays need legs from different games.
Official inactives came out about 15 minutes before this card and I could not pull the full lists; Pittman is not on the injury report, so check he is active before placing.
Steelers are without RB Rico Dowdle and CB Joey Porter Jr. (traded); Browns are without C Elgton Jenkins, G Teven Jenkins and WR Tylan Wallace.
